object.description: Open a document in the Document Editor, which opens in read-only mode. Expected: Compare… is enabled, and stays enabled after leaving read-only mode and entering it again; choosing it opens the Compare dialog and shows a comparison. A comparison made while edits are refused gives the same changes as one made while they are allowed.
